resolution.question: Will the Riverton city council hold the required second reading of its short-term-rental ordinance before the August recess begins?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the Riverton city council actually held the second reading of the short-term-rental ordinance before the start of the August recess. Otherwise resolve NO at the start of the recess or at the hard cutoff, whichever comes first.
